describes: packages/core/signature: verifyCmsSignature, buildDetachedCms and the completion gate.

cases.name: build-rsa-cades
cases.covers: A CAdES-B CMS: content-type, message-digest and ESS signing-certificate-v2, signed over the attribute SET.

cases.name: build-rsa-pkcs7-time
cases.covers: A PKCS#7 CMS carries the signing-time attribute it was given, as UTCTime.

cases.name: build-rsa-pkcs7-no-time
cases.covers: A PKCS#7 CMS without a signing time has only content-type and message-digest.

cases.name: build-cades-ignores-time
cases.covers: CAdES never carries signing-time, even when one is passed.

cases.name: build-pss-sha256
cases.covers: RSASSA-PSS parameters for sha256: hash, MGF1 over the same hash, salt the hash length.

cases.name: build-pss-sha384
cases.covers: RSASSA-PSS parameters for sha384: hash, MGF1 over the same hash, salt the hash length.

cases.name: build-pss-sha512
cases.covers: RSASSA-PSS parameters for sha512: hash, MGF1 over the same hash, salt the hash length.

cases.name: build-ecdsa-p256
cases.covers: ECDSA: the raw r||s becomes a DER SEQUENCE of two INTEGERs.

cases.name: build-ecdsa-p521
cases.covers: ECDSA over P-521 in a PKCS#7 CMS; r and s are 66 bytes each.

cases.name: build-ecdsa-odd-length
cases.covers: An ECDSA answer of odd length encodes as an empty signature.

cases.name: build-ecdsa-leading-zeros
cases.covers: Leading zero bytes of r and s are stripped, and a high bit gets a zero byte.

cases.name: build-wrong-digest-length
cases.covers: A digest whose length does not fit the hash is refused before anything is signed.

cases.name: build-signer-hash-mismatch
cases.covers: A signer that hashes with another algorithm than the document was prepared with is refused.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: the signer hashes with sha384, the document was prepared with sha256

cases.name: build-no-certificate
cases.covers: A signer without a certificate is refused.

cases.name: build-signer-rejects
cases.covers: A signer that rejects rejects the build with its error.

cases.name: build-bad-certificate
cases.covers: A chain entry that is not a certificate throws pkijs's error.

$error.name: AsnError
$error.message: Error during parsing of ASN.1 data. Data is not correct for 'Certificate'.

cases.name: gate-cades-ok
cases.covers: A CAdES CMS over the prepared digest passes.

cases.name: gate-pkcs7-ok
cases.covers: A PKCS#7 CMS passes the PKCS#7 profile, signing-time and all.

cases.name: gate-too-large
cases.covers: A CMS bigger than the reserved /Contents is refused first.

resolved.detail: the CMS is 2347 bytes; 100 were reserved

cases.name: gate-malformed
cases.covers: A CMS that does not parse is `malformed`, with the parser's message.

resolved.detail: CMS has 2 signers; exactly one is expected

cases.name: gate-malformed-type-error
cases.covers: A parser failure that is not a CmsError reports its text.

resolved.detail: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0')

cases.name: gate-algorithm-mismatch
cases.covers: A CMS digesting with another algorithm than prepared.

resolved.detail: the CMS digests with sha384, the document was prepared with sha256

cases.name: gate-digest-mismatch
cases.covers: A CMS whose message digest is not the prepared digest.

resolved.detail: the CMS message digest is not the prepared digest

cases.name: gate-digest-length-mismatch
cases.covers: A prepared digest of another length is a digest mismatch, not an error.

resolved.detail: the CMS message digest is not the prepared digest
CAdES requires the ESS signing-certificate-v2 attribute

cases.name: gate-cades-with-time
cases.covers: PAdES forbids signing-time; checked after the ESS attribute.

resolved.detail: PAdES forbids the CMS signing-time attribute

cases.name: gate-pkcs7-with-time
cases.covers: The same CMS is refused for its signature, not its profile, under PKCS#7.

cases.name: gate-signature-invalid
cases.covers: A signature that does not verify.

cases.name: gate-signature-unsupported
cases.covers: An unsupported algorithm is refused with its own detail.

resolved.detail: the signature algorithm is not supported
